text.en: Learning robust perceptive locomotion is row 116 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Robots area.
text.zh: Learning robust perceptive locomotion 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 116 行，所属领域为“机器人”。

text.en: The annual table associates Learning robust perceptive locomotion with “Learning robust perceptive locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Learning robust perceptive locomotion 与论文《Learning robust perceptive locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Takahiro Miki”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Takahiro Miki（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Takahiro Miki”。
